note: Fixed test layout. 'place' puts a resident (frozen, facing +z, walks no more) or an officer (still, can be shot) at x, z (world tiles; 1 tile ≈ 20 m). A shot with 'target' stands 'distance' (default 0.12) tiles west of that subject and looks at its chest (a side view). Shots without target use 'from' and 'at'. 'frames' are screenshot times in ms after the shot (wall clock: a headless run renders slowly, so take a few).
